_doc: Everyday life of the people (life.gd, sim.life): meals at the fire, waking, how fast people walk, weariness (fatigue), spirits (morale), the bonds between families, the idle acts people choose when nobody needs them, and the short things they say. Each person is one family line: a child starts a new line, kin to the line it came from. Times are seconds unless named *_days; day parts are fractions of the day (sim.day_frac(): 0.74 night falls, 0.96 dawn). Texts are English translation keys. See docs/CONFIG.md.

meals._doc: In each of `times` (day parts) people who are hungrier than hungry_below put down the work listed in `jobs` ('' = no work, 'life' = an idle act) and eat a meal. Where they eat is one rule for everyone, weighed: the company at the nearest fire (no further than `reach`) is worth `fire_bonus` seconds of walking there and back, for up to `fire_crowd` people: each one already at it takes that share of the bonus, so a crowded ring is no company at all. A house that is already warm is worth `indoors_bonus` of it. Whoever gains more by staying eats where they stand (the farmer in the field, the woodcutter at the tree; a maker at work indoors eats there, hidden and warm), the rest gather in a ring round the fire (`seat`). Those who eat near each other still grow closer (bond_reach). They eat up to a full meal (survival meal_fill) for food in proportion (survival meal per meal_fill), then go back to work. People far away still eat from the stores when very hungry (survival eat_below).

wake._doc: At dawn people take a moment before the day's work.

pace._doc: Walking speed multipliers: weariness above tired_from slows people by up to tired_slow; the starving walk at `hungry`; in an alarm, a crisis or flight people hurry.

fatigue._doc: 0..100 per person. Work raises it per second (lazy people tire faster), idling, eating and idle acts lower it, sleep clears it. Above work_from it slows work by up to work_loss at 100. tired_at is when idle acts count someone as tired.

morale._doc: 0..100 per person: the tribe's mood plus what weighs on or lifts this family (hunger, sickness, wounds, weariness, grief, praise, friends, rivals working nearby). It moves `step` per second. Work speed changes by work_per for each point above or below the tribe's mood. low/high are the idle acts' low_spirits and high_spirits.

praise._doc: Cheer (fading morale) for a person's own deeds.

leave._doc: A family whose spirits stay below `below` for `days` days may want to leave: the chieftain is asked (dilemma 'discontent' in config/dilemmas.json), at most every every_days days, never with fewer than min_pop people.

bonds._doc: Bonds between two families, -100..100: friends at friend_at and above (close at close_at), rivals at rival_at and below. A child starts at `kin` with the family it came from. At the start each family has `start` friends and maybe a rival. Bonds grow per second working within `near` of each other (each with at most `max_near` of the others near: in a crowd one works beside a few), fighting the same foe, dancing at a festival, and per chat (a quarrel instead costs quarrel.loss). Friends working nearby speed work (work_bonus each, up to work_bonus_max); rivals nearby slow it. A death grieves those bonded at grieve_at or more (kin always): grief = grief + grief_per x bond.

idle._doc: What grown-ups at home do when nobody needs them: every `every` seconds of idling one act is picked, weighted by `weight` plus `more` for each condition that holds. `needs`: conditions that must all hold; `when`: tribe conditions as in scenario scripts (story.holds). Conditions: dusk, morning, cold, wet, tired, hurt, hungry, grieving, low_spirits, high_spirits, children, kin_child, can_art, trait:<trait>. Verbs (do): sit (at: fire, here, shelter, grave, edge), chat, work (a chore at home; `inside`: done in the house, hidden and sheltered as a craft is, sim.own_hut(); or `near` one of our buildings of that type; arms_xp: weapon practice a second with the weapon they carry, arms.gd), water, watch (the children), gaze, ritual (lasts until new orders), art (folk.gd), wander. acts: [walking there, doing it] ('%s': the other person); pose: the drawn pose there (sit, talk, build, gather, ritual).

speech._doc: Speech marks over people's heads: shown for `time` seconds, at most max_shown at once, a person speaks at most once per `gap` seconds. Each second someone with a need (hungry, cold, sick, tired) says so with need_chance. Lines are picked from `talk` by situation; a '<situation>:<trait>' list is used half the time for people of that trait. '%s' is the other person's name.

chat: Saw deer tracks by the water.
My grandmother told of a winter worse than any.
The berries are ripening on the far slope.
Did you hear the wolves last night?
chat:belligerent: Let any clan come. I'll be waiting.
chat:cautious: We should check the stores again.
chat:gluttonous: I could eat a whole aurochs.
chat:lazy: Why hurry? The river isn't going anywhere.
friend: You always know how to make me laugh.
Our families should share a fire.
quarrel: That was my catch, not yours!
Keep your family away from my hut!
eating: A full belly, a warm fire.
fire: Tell the story of the first hunters again.
Look how the sparks fly up.
morning: The birds are loud this morning.
Up, up, the day won't wait.
tired: I need to sit a while.
cold: The cold bites to the bone.
too_far_cold: Too far in this cold. I'd never make it back.
Not out there, not in this cold.
too_far_cold:belligerent: Even I won't walk that far in this cold.
turn_back: No further. Home while I still can.
turn_back:cautious: Far enough. The fire, before the cold takes me.
flood_wait: Not across that water. We wait.
The river will drop. Then we go.
beast_clear: Not there. The beast is close.
I'll keep my distance from that one.
birth: A new family in the tribe!
kids: Careful, don't go near the water!
They play just like we did.
